topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Well now, what do you reckon this means? A gift come all the way from young Thomas, who’s off seeing the big cities and the wide world. Never did I think, when I was showin’ him how to tend the sheep and read the signs in the clouds, that he’d remember the old sayings and the ways of the earth. But here it is, a fine little book bound in leather, with my name etched right on the cover. The pages are filled with stories of his travels, but more than that, words of thanks for the lessons I thought were just part and parcel of growin’ up. He even wrote how one of my old stories about the kindness of Saint Francis made him help a man in need. Seems like the old ways still hold their weight, even out there beyond the hills.
